concerns.text: Constitution I (Reproducibility) requires all sources of randomness to be pinned. The synthetic generation script invoked by T001 (`code/data/generate_synthetic.py`) is not seeded, violating the reproducibility mandate.

Functional Requirement FR-010 mandates that the dataset be split into training and hold‑out validation sets before any analysis. No task creates this split; T008 and T009 assume the split exists, leaving FR-010 unimplemented.

Success Criterion SC-001 expects a single feature‑value complexity threshold where static detection probability = 0.5. T009 produces a separate threshold for each predictor, weakening the measurable outcome defined in the spec.

FR-010 also requires reporting the stability of the 0.5‑probability threshold across the k‑fold cross‑validation folds. T008 only records mean AUC and does not capture threshold stability, thus partially omitting the required FR.
